newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank to announce Kwong Yik deal.
newsitem.headline: Maybank to announce Kwong Yik deal.

text.p: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) said on Monday that it will announce a deal to sell its stake in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd to Rashid Hussain Bhd on Tuesday.
A spokeswoman at Malaysia's largest commercial bank said a news conference is set for 5 p.m. (0900 GMT) on Tuesday, to be presided over by Maybank managing director Amir Sham Aziz.

Stockbroker Rashid Hussain has been in talks at least since last month to buy the 75 percent of Kwong Yik owned by Maybank. Shares of all three stocks have been suspended since October 21 for an announcement.
A spokesman at Rashid Hussain said on Monday that the company is also set to hold a news conference on Tuesday, likely before the Maybank meeting.
Analysts said they believe Rashid and Maybank have settled on a price of 8.75 ringgit to 8.85 ringgit a share for the Kwong Yik shares, or over two billion ringgit in total.

The stock of DCB Holdings Bhd, Rashid's 20-percent owned associate banking unit, had also been suspended while the deal has been negotiated. Rashid runs Malaysia's largest institutional stockbrokerage.

Banks in Malaysia have been urged by the government to merge in order to beef up capital in the face of increasing competition from foreign institutions and ahead of the liberalisation of financial markets.
